summary: REQ-6 appears implemented (AAB build script runs a questions integrity check first). A questions integrity check script was added (REQ-5), but based on the diff it may not be runnable as a single local/CI command because it is a TypeScript file invoked via plain `node`. Only one questions dataset file (Class 9) is shown as repaired; evidence for repairs to the other required question modules (Class 6, 7, 8, 10) is not present in the diff summary. Several unrequested product features are described/introduced in documentation and summaries (e.g., gamified UI, timer, background music).

missing_requirements.requirement: Repair malformed/truncated quiz question data modules so the frontend bundler can compile successfully for all specified files (questions.js, questions_class7.js, questions_class8.js, questions_class9.js, questions_class10.js), each being a valid JS module exporting a default array.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary only shows a modification to `frontend/src/data/questions_class9.js`. There is no diff evidence that `frontend/src/data/questions.js`, `frontend/src/data/questions_class7.js`, `frontend/src/data/questions_class8.js`, or `frontend/src/data/questions_class10.js` were repaired/verified to be syntactically complete `export default [...]` modules.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a pre-build questions integrity check runnable as a single command/script in local/CI that imports all datasets (Class 6–10), runs existing validation logic, prints clear English errors, and exits non-zero on failure (including syntax/import failures).
missing_requirements.reason: Although `frontend/scripts/check-questions-integrity.ts` was added and `build-release-aab.sh` invokes it via `node scripts/check-questions-integrity.ts`, the check script is a `.ts` file and appears to be executed with plain `node` (no evidence of ts-node/tsx compilation step). This may not satisfy the requirement of a runnable single command in typical CI/local environments.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced/advertised major UI/feature changes (e.g., 'gamified UI', animations, timed questions, background music) which are outside the stated non-goals and not requested by REQ-4/5/6.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists non-goals like not redesigning the app UI/visual theme and not adding new functionality beyond repairing question data and adding a validation check. The diff includes documentation/summaries describing these new features.
